flags.why: “Đáp lại tệ bạc ơn” is not a natural Vietnamese construction.
flags.fix: Nó đối xử tệ bạc với người đã cưu mang mình. = He treated the person who had taken him in ungratefully.

flags.why: Using “đụt” to mean taking shelter from rain is regional Southern usage.
The example explains the title instead of showing it in use.
flags.fix: Bà thành tâm cầu nguyện trước tượng Phật Như Lai. = She prayed devoutly before the statue of the Buddha.

flags.why: “Anh hàng xóm” means the male neighbour, not the neighbour's son.
flags.fix: Grandma matched my sister with the male neighbour.

flags.why: The figurative meaning is to suffer attacks or harsh criticism, not specifically to be torn limb from limb.
flags.fix: to take a beating; to suffer harsh criticism
